name: Mushi no Ou ~Subete no Mesu wa Waga Shison no Naedoko~
original_name: 蟲の王～全テノ雌ハ我ガ子孫ノ苗床～
source:
Humans and insects had been avoiding conflict by not encroaching on each other's territory. As a result, the insects had been sharing some of the benefits born from the deep forest with humans. However, a little over a decade ago, humanity stole "power" from the Insect King and sealed him deep within the forest. With the power gained from the insects, humans increased their national strength, eventually forgetting their fear and reverence for the forest, instead encroaching upon it. Then one day, adventurers exploring the depths of the forest were violated and brutally murdered, sparking the beginning of a series of events.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1251677]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
人类和昆虫一直通过不侵犯彼此的领地来避免冲突。结果，昆虫与人类分享了森林深处带来的一些好处。然而十多年前，人类窃取了虫王的“力量”，并将其封印在森林深处。人类借助昆虫的力量增强了国力，最终忘记了对森林的恐惧和敬畏，转而侵占森林。然后有一天，探索森林深处的冒险者遭到侵犯并惨遭杀害，引发了一系列事件的开始。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1251677]Getchu[/url]]
